12-27.sp: You go looking alone, which suits your temperament and your position equally.
12-27.wk: In charge and isolated. That's the trade rather than a failure of the people around you.
12-27.ri: Taken alone with no check. Get one outside view purely as a discipline.
12-27.ou: Respected. Find someone who knew you before the position, because only they see all of it.
12-27.we: isolated · won't consult · carries it alone
12-27.ad: Find one peer who owes you nothing. Every leader needs one and most never get one.
12-27.cl: The chair at the head is a chair on its own.
12-27.m: Capricorn I — The Week of the Ruler · Earth · Cardinal · 9 Mars · The Hermit

12-28.t: The Day of the Long Reign
12-28.d: You've held a position through several turns of the wheel — good years, bad years, and the stretches where everyone else left. That endurance is the whole story of you, and it's produced something that couldn't have been built any faster.
12-28.lo: Your relationships have chapters and what survived a full turn is real. You know exactly which those are.
12-28.mo: Feast and famine, and you save in the feast because you've been through the other one.
12-28.fa: They've seen every version of you and stopped being surprised by any of them.
12-28.em: Steady with long slow shifts, and your lows genuinely lift.
12-28.fr: Some knew one season only. That's not betrayal, it's the arithmetic of a long life.
12-28.mi: At the bottom you're hardest on yourself and least accurate. No permanent decisions down there.
12-28.bo: Energy in cycles. Work with them rather than expecting the flat line you've never had.
12-28.sp: You've seen it turn several times, which is more useful than most beliefs held with more conviction.
12-28.wk: One long thing rather than several. That's unusual now and it's produced something the job-hoppers don't have.
12-28.ri: You'll go again after a loss, which is fine if something changed rather than just the year.
12-28.ou: It turns and you're still standing, which has been the pattern and will be again.
12-28.we: slow to change · restless in the trough · hard on yourself
12-28.ad: Judge yourself over a whole cycle. Never at the bottom of one.
12-28.cl: The wheel turns for the one on top too.
12-28.m: Capricorn I — The Week of the Ruler · Earth · Cardinal · 1 Sun · The Wheel of Fortune

12-29.t: The Day of the Straight Rule
12-29.d: You govern fairly, whether that's a business, a family, or a team, and you feel the weight of every ruling you make. That conscience is why people accept your authority. It's also why you turn decisions over long after they're made and working.
12-29.lo: You keep it even, sometimes too even. Let someone give you more than you gave without immediately settling up.
12-29.mo: Honest to your own cost. You've left money on the table on principle more than once.
12-29.fa: Everyone brings you their case and expects a ruling. That job was never offered and never refused.
12-29.em: You feel unfairness physically before you can argue it, and on yourself the verdict is always harsh.
12-29.fr: People trust you not to abuse the position, which is exactly why the position works.
12-29.mi: You carry other people's disputes. Set a limit, because they accumulate and don't fall away.
12-29.bo: Stress lands in your gut and your sleep, and it's usually an unmade decision.
12-29.sp: You believe it balances out, and that belief has been holding a great deal up.
12-29.wk: The fair one in charge. People stay with you for years and rarely say it's because of that.
12-29.ri: Cautious because you're thinking who else gets hurt. Take one that's only about you.
12-29.ou: Respected in a way that outlasts the position, which is the only kind that counts.
12-29.ad: Stop reviewing decisions you already made well. Move forward.
12-29.cl: The scale doesn't weigh the one holding it.
12-29.m: Capricorn I — The Week of the Ruler · Earth · Cardinal · 2 Moon · Justice

12-30.t: The Day of the Held Succession
12-30.d: You're holding something that needs to pass to somebody else eventually, and you haven't started that. Part of it is that nobody's ready. Part of it is that you don't know who you are without it, and that's the harder half.
12-30.lo: You've waited on something and it resolves. The waiting has cost more than the outcome will.
12-30.mo: Flat then a shift. Judge over years rather than during the holding.
12-30.fa: Something's waiting on you to let go of it. They've noticed and none of them will raise it.
12-30.em: Frustration humming underneath at being stuck in a role that's finished.
12-30.fr: Patient people who've watched you hold on longer than you needed to.
12-30.mi: The holding is the risk now rather than the letting go. That's a reversal you haven't accepted yet.
12-30.bo: Blocked energy needs an outlet, particularly when the main thing has stopped moving.
12-30.sp: Letting go rather than gripping. That's the card and it's the assignment you've been deferring.
12-30.wk: Train a successor. That's the last real job of anybody who ran something and you've been avoiding it.
12-30.ri: You wait too long. The handover you keep postponing gets harder every year you postpone it.
12-30.ou: It passes on, and you'll find out you were more than the role. That's the part you're dreading and it's the good part.
12-30.we: won't let go · identity in the role · stalls
12-30.ad: Name a successor this year. Not eventually — this year.
12-30.cl: Hanging on and holding up are different jobs.
12-30.m: Capricorn I — The Week of the Ruler · Earth · Cardinal · 3 Jupiter · The Empress

12-31.t: The Day of the Closed Year
12-31.d: You're born at the end of the count, and you've always been the one who closes things out — the accounts, the arguments, the chapter. You finish what other people leave hanging, and then you decide what comes next.
12-31.lo: You've ended things properly rather than letting them drift. That's harder and cleaner and they respect it eventually.
12-31.mo: You settle up. Nothing's left open, nothing's owed, and your position is exactly what you say it is.
12-31.fa: The one who closes the loop. That's kept several old things from festering.
12-31.em: Firm outside, and what's underneath rarely gets shown. There's more of it than anyone would guess.
12-31.fr: Loyal absolutely. Cross a line and it's permanent, and everyone knows the terms going in.
12-31.mi: Being told what to do gets to you and pressure doesn't. That distinction explains your entire working history.
12-31.bo: Your own program, held for years. Anything imposed dies within a fortnight.
12-31.sp: Endings as a discipline. You've closed things properly that other people are still carrying.
12-31.wk: You end up in charge, and you'll be the one who winds it up or hands it over cleanly.
12-31.ri: You commit hard without hedging, which is why what you close stays closed.
12-31.ou: You finish. Whatever else is true about you, nothing you started is still hanging.
12-31.st: decisive · responsible · final in a good way
12-31.we: rigid · won't reverse · closes too early
12-31.ad: Before you close it, check whether it was finished or just difficult.
12-31.cl: The last day of the count is still a day.
12-31.m: Capricorn I — The Week of the Ruler · Earth · Cardinal · 4 Uranus · The Emperor
